answer: Pay for marginal contribution, not mere presence. The summit of each epoch's reward ladder should sit on skill-complementary task bundles, with every identity's share set by leave-one-out attribution on the ledger: remove the agent from the transcript and measure what was actually lost. A reef of clone identities adds no new capability, so copies two through N earn near zero and the farm's revenue collapses to one agent's wage. Distinctive skill is the only oasis that pays, and staffing genuinely different minds costs the attacker the exact expense the sybil trick was meant to dodge.
